display.description: Every AI call routed through ai-meter (:8107): who is calling, which provider and model, what it costs at the reference price table, how slow it is, and whether the metering itself is healthy. Feeds the AI Upstream Failure Rate rule; built after the 2026-10-17 Z.ai 1113 outage (coding-plan key on the general endpoint) went unobserved for hours.
display.name: AI Meter — Routed AI Calls

display.description: Calls the proxy could not get through: the retry budget ran out, the wait timed out, or the quota was spent. The client received an error.
display.name: Calls Lost to Admission (24h)

display.description: How calls to a throttled upstream left the proxy: admitted (sent once), absorbed (a rate-limit rejection was retried and answered), gave_up, timeout, circuit, cancelled.
display.name: Admission Outcomes (24h)

display.description: Per throttled upstream: calls sent (in flight), calls queued for room (waiting), and the concurrency the proxy currently allows (limit). The limit drops by one per rate-limit rejection and grows back after a quiet half minute.
display.name: Admission: In Flight, Waiting, Limit

display.description: Mean seconds a call spent queued for upstream room.
display.name: Avg Admission Wait

display.description: Mean wall time of a completed call over the last 15 minutes, streaming and not.
display.name: Avg Duration

display.description: Mean time to the first streamed byte over the last 15 minutes (streaming calls only). This is the wait a user feels before text appears.
display.name: Avg TTFT

display.description: Share of prompt tokens served from the provider's prompt cache (cached is a subset of prompt). Higher is cheaper: a cached input token costs a fraction of a fresh one. Only meaningful for models with prompt caching.
display.name: Cache Hit Rate

display.description: Mean wall time per completed call per model.
display.name: Avg Duration by Model

display.description: Calls per minute that did not return 200: upstream 429s, 5xx, timeouts and client cancellations. Orange past 2/min, red past 10/min.
display.name: Non-2xx / min

display.description: Share of a provider's calls that did not return 200. This is the panel that names which upstream is failing while the overall success rate drops.
display.name: Error Rate by Provider

display.description: Non-200 calls per minute by HTTP status.
display.name: Failures by Code

display.description: Calls inside the proxy right now, all providers. In flight means the client is waiting on ai-meter; it says nothing about whether the upstream is throttling (see Admission).
display.name: In Flight

display.description: Concurrent calls per client (the service holding the key) over time. One client hogging the upstream is visible here first.
display.name: In Flight by Client

display.description: Concurrent calls per model over time.
display.name: In Flight by Model

display.description: Concurrent calls per upstream over time. A line that sits pinned at z.ai's cliff (about 6 to 9 before admission control) is the shape that produced the 429 storms.
display.name: In Flight by Provider

display.description: Every combination with a call in flight right now, busiest first. An empty table means nothing is waiting. `none` is a call whose request body named no model (embeddings, non-chat routes).
display.name: In Flight: Provider x Model x Client

display.description: Calls whose token usage could not be read from the response or written to the ledger. The call itself still succeeded, but its tokens and cost are missing.
display.name: Metering Errors (24h)

display.description: Calls, tokens and success per model over the last 24 hours, one row per model. Spend is not a column on purpose: the cost counter restates when a price row lands, so a 24-hour increase of it would report the restatement as spend (see the spend panels above).
display.name: Models: Last 24 Hours

display.description: True while z.ai reports a spent usage window: the proxy sends nothing until the reset time the answer named.
display.name: Quota Exhausted

display.description: HTTP 429 answers from throttled upstreams by business code: rate_limit (too much at once; retried within the budget) or quota (a usage window is spent).
display.name: Upstream Rejections: Last 24 Hours

display.description: Calls per minute per model, split by HTTP status. A 429 line rising under a model means that upstream is throttling it.
display.name: Requests by Model x Code

display.description: Calls per minute per upstream.
display.name: Requests by Provider

display.description: Completed AI calls per minute over the last 5 minutes.
display.name: Requests / min

display.description: How often the proxy process started in the last 24 hours. Every deploy restarts it and every start resets the counters; a count that climbs without a deploy is a crash loop.
display.name: Starts (24h)

display.description: Calls whose trace span never reached SigNoz (the OTLP endpoint rejected it or the export queue dropped it). Those calls are metered but invisible in the trace explorer.
display.name: Span Export Failures (24h)

display.description: Spans per minute by how handing them to SigNoz went: ok, failed, dropped.
display.name: Span Export by Outcome

display.description: Completion tokens per second of generation: output tokens divided by (wall time minus time to first byte). Generation speed of the model behind the provider, independent of queueing.
display.name: Output Speed by Model

display.description: Reference cost per hour: tokens x the price table in services.ai-meter.costs, computed at query time so a late price row restates the whole history. What the traffic WOULD cost pay-as-you-go, not what the coding plan bills.
display.name: Spend Rate

display.description: Reference cost per hour per priced model.
display.name: Spend Rate by Model

display.description: Reference cost since the ledger began, at today's price table. The proxy replays the ledger at every start, so a price change reaches this number from the next start on; unpriced models count as 0.
display.name: Spend (all-time)

display.description: Share of routed AI calls returning 2xx. Dropped to ~7% during the 2026-10-17 Z.ai 1113 balance outage - this panel + the failure-rate rule exist to catch that class within minutes. Empty while no call is in the window.
display.name: Success Rate (5m)

display.description: Tokens per minute. cached is a subset of prompt (the part served from the provider's prompt cache).
display.name: Tokens by Kind

display.description: All tokens per minute over the last 5 minutes: prompt, cached and completion.
display.name: Tokens / min

display.description: Share of completed calls whose span is in SigNoz.
display.name: Traced Calls (24h)

display.description: Mean time to first streamed byte per model.
display.name: Avg TTFT by Model

display.description: Calls rejected before any upstream was contacted: unknown client key.
display.name: Unauthorized (24h)

display.description: True while SigNoz scrapes the proxy's metrics endpoint. False means the proxy is down or the scrape is broken, and every other panel is stale.
display.name: Reachable

display.description: Time since the proxy last started. Every counter below restarts here, so a short uptime explains a small all-time spend.
display.name: Process Uptime
